reasoning: The agent goes beyond a single happy-path curl — it checks health across all three nodes, greps the served UI HTML, and re-runs python HTTP test scripts iteratively after edits — placing it above the level-3 'ad hoc curls / UI eyeballed once' anchor. But it never demonstrably exercises WebSocket subscribe/resume, IRC join/privmsg, or SPA driving, and shows zero resilience or seq-density testing, so it falls clearly short of the level-5 'each subsystem's main paths' bar. Confidence is low because the trajectory is only a bare tool-call index and the contents of the python heredoc scripts (which may contain more) are not visible.
